thread:
alex: Heads up — customers in eu-west are seeing intermittent SAML assertion signature verification failures since ~02:15 UTC. Happening for ~5% of logins, only SAML (OIDC looks fine).

maria: Thanks for flagging. Any recent changes to KMS or cert rotation?

alex: We rotated a KMS key for the signing key material earlier (01:58 UTC). Rotation finished normally but I see a few 400s in the IDP logs.

samir: Can you paste the verifier error?

alex: 
```
2026-03-21T02:16:23Z verifier=prod idp_id=acme-corp err="signature verification failed: key not found: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/xxxx"
```

julie: Hmm looks like the assertion consumer still tried the old key id. Could be cache TTL for jwks/kms mapping.

security-bot: ALERT: 6 login failures in 3m for tenant=acme-corp (saml_signature_error). Investigate key mapping TTLs.

maria: If the signing key was rewrapped with a new KMS key, some services may still have the old key id in cache. Stale JWKS/JWK-KMS binding can cause verification to fallback to missing key.

alex: We're also seeing missing audit events for deprovision events around the same time window (02:00-02:20). RBAC prune jobs ran at 02:05. Possible ordering race?

tanner: Could be two concurrent operations: key rotation + role prune. If assertion fails, downstream deprovision webhook might have dropped before audit log flush. Need to check queue/backpressure.

ops: I checked the kafka lag — prune job produced events to provisioning-topic, consumer lag jumped to 0 quickly but sink to audit-db shows a few missing offsets (2033-2037).

samir: Do we have proof of dropped messages or simply consumer errors?

ops: Consumer reported transient 502s from audit-service at 02:06 causing retries; after 02:08 it recovered. Some messages expired per retry policy.

julie: That explains the missing audit entries. Two independent issues: assertion signature errors (KMS/jwk mapping) + audit retention loss (consumer retry expiry). Both triggered around rotation time.

maria: Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) rollback to previous KMS alias if possible for affected tenants, 2) bump jwks/kms-mapping TTLs to 30s while we stabilize, 3) replay failed provisioning offsets into audit pipeline.

alex: For rollback I can re-alias the KMS key to the old alias but that requires a small maintenance window. Want to confirm impact before doing so.

samir: Before rollback, try forcing a JWKS refresh on the verifier nodes to see if that clears signature errors. Command: 
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it verifier-XXXX -- curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/refresh-jwks
```

alex: Running refresh now...

alex: Response: 200 OK, refreshed keys=3. Errors dropped to near-zero over next 30s.

security-bot: NOTE: refresh triggered by alex at 02:18 UTC.

ops: Replaying offsets 2033-2037 to audit-topic now (idempotent replay).

julie: Good — that should restore missing audit rows. After replay completes, please verify audit counts against auth logs for 02:00-02:20.

maria: Longer term: make KMS->JWKS mapping update transactional with rotation workflow. Also add a pre-rotation canary to verify verifier nodes pick up keys within 60s.

tanner: Also add metrics: jwks-refresh-duration, jwks-stale-count, verifier-failed-keys-rate. Alert when failed-keys-rate > 0.5% over 5m.

alex: Opened infra ticket INFRA-2319 for jwks TTL and metrics.

samir: One more note: RBAC prune job should checkpoint only after audit sink ack. Prevents lost deprovision audit events. Filed SEC-879 for policy change.

ops: Replay complete, audit rows backfilled (6 rows). Verified counts match auth log for acme-corp during window.

alex: Thanks — rolling TTL bump and canary plan next. Will schedule a brief maintenance note for KMS alias rebind if needed.

maria: Thanks everyone. Postmortem please include timeline, root cause (rotation + cache TTL + audit retry expiry), mitigation actions (replay, refresh, TTL bump), and followups (INFRA-2319, SEC-879).

alex: Will draft POV and ping for review. :thumbsup:
